title: Internal Sales & Customer Service Advisor
company: Optima UK Inc Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Internal Sales & Customer Service Advisor

Location: Tamworth, Staffordshire
Salary: 27,000 per annum + uncapped commission
Hours: Monday to Thursday, 8:30am - 5:00pm Friday, 8:30am - 2:30pm
Job Type: Full-time

About the Role

Are you a confident salesperson who enjoys building customer relationships, generating new business and closing sales?

We are recruiting on behalf of an established and successful business based in Tamworth, looking to appoint an Internal Sales & Customer Service Advisor to join its growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in internal sales, telesales, account management or customer service with a strong sales focus.

You will be responsible for managing existing customer accounts, following up sales opportunities, securing service agreement renewals and developing new business through proactive outbound calls.

With a 27,000 basic salary, uncapped commission and an early finish every Friday, this role offers an excellent opportunity to increase your earnings while developing a long-term career.

What's on Offer?
- 27,000 basic salary plus uncapped commission
- Monday to Friday working hours with a 2:30pm finish on Fridays
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Additional annual leave based on length of service
- 5% company pension contribution
- Long-term career development and progression opportunities
- Access to private health and wellbeing support, including 24/7 online GP appointments
- Enhanced family leave benefits
- Income protection and death in service cover
- Additional employee wellbeing and financial support benefits

The Role
- Proactively contact existing customers and sales leads to generate new orders and increase account revenue.
- Manage and develop allocated customer accounts, identifying opportunities for additional business.
- Follow up outstanding quotations, handle objections and convert enquiries into confirmed sales.
- Secure planned service agreement renewals and identify opportunities for additional cover.
- Re-engage dormant customers and build relationships to encourage repeat business.
- Work closely with internal departments and field-based colleagues to prepare accurate quotations.
- Respond to customer enquiries and resolve issues professionally and efficiently.
- Maintain accurate customer records, process orders and manage sales pipeline activity.
- Work towards agreed sales targets, with opportunities to earn uncapped commission.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in internal sales, telesales, account management, renewals or a customer service role involving sales.
- A proven track record of achieving sales targets or securing customer renewals.
- Confidence making outbound sales calls and converting opportunities into orders.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to build and maintain customer relationships.
- A proactive, target-driven approach with the confidence to follow up quotations and close sales.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence using customer management systems and maintaining accurate records.
- A willingness to learn about technical products and services.

Experience working with business customers, service agreements or technical products would be advantageous but is not essential.

Apply Now

If you have a strong sales background, enjoy building customer relationships and want a role where your performance is rewarded through uncapped commission, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity in Tamworth.
